title: Root Prefix Sum Count
statement:
Count root-to-node prefixes whose values add to a target.

Contract
- `root` may be null; nodes hold integer values.
- Count only downward paths that start at the root and end at any node.
- Return 0 for an empty tree.

Examples
- `[5, 3, -1, 2, 1, null, 4]`, target `8` returns `2`.
- `[1, 2, 3]`, target `1` returns `1`.
hints: Carry a running sum from the root.
A node counts when the running sum including it equals the target.
Visit each node once. Intended complexity: O(n) time and O(h) call stack space.
inputSyntax: Input: a level-order tree, then target=<sum>, for example: [5, 3, -1, 2, 1, null, 4] target=8
